title: Shophouse bakery counter in oak and olive
summary: A long oak service counter with a fluted front and a stone-look top runs along a heritage shophouse unit. Olive wall tiles and warm pendants frame the bread display, while terrazzo-look flooring and timber shutters keep the shophouse character.
